name: coveragepy_5dbb_public_delivery_v1
purpose: 固定公开题面经 PreparedTaskFace、真实 Claude Code 和桩端点交付；只执行公开环境检查、题面复现与公开测试。此剧本不执行求解修改。

steps.command: id; echo VIRTUAL_ENV=$VIRTUAL_ENV; echo RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=$( ( : >> /rh2/bash_env ) 2>/dev/null && echo WRITABLE || echo DENIED ); python -c 'import sys; print("RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE="+sys.executable)'; python -c 'import coverage; print("cwd=testbed coverage", coverage.__file__, coverage.__version__)'; (cd /tmp && python -c 'import coverage; print("cwd=tmp coverage", coverage.__file__)'); python -m pip --version 2>&1 | head -1; python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1; git status --porcelain=v1; echo PORCELAIN_RC=$?

cd "$(mktemp -d)" && python - <<'PY'
import coverage
cov = coverage.Coverage()
cov.load()
cov._warn("Warning, warning 1!", slug="bot", once=True)
cov._warn("Warning, warning 2!", slug="bot", once=True)
PY
cd "$(mktemp -d)" && PYTHONPATH=/testbed python -c 'import coverage; print(coverage.__file__); cov = coverage.Coverage(); cov.load(); cov._warn("Warning, warning 1!", slug="bot", once=True)'
python -m pytest -o addopts="" -p no:cacheprovider --color=no -rfE tests/test_api.py tests/test_testing.py -k warn
